MATHEMATICS — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #7
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: MATHEMATICS
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
ASSESSMENT: CBC school-based practice paper

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show your working and write the units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the one best answer.
4. Check your work before you hand in.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Achieng buys 3 packets of flour of 1/2 kg each and 2 packets of sugar of 1 kg each. What is the total mass? (1 mark)
   A. 2 1/2 kg
   B. 3 kg
   C. 5 kg
   D. 3 1/2 kg

2. What is the total value of the digit 9 in 3.09? (1 mark)
   A. 0.9
   B. 9
   C. 0.009
   D. 0.09

3. Which unit is used for area? (1 mark)
   A. Litres
   B. Square centimetres
   C. Kilograms
   D. Centimetres

4. What is 27 × 20? (1 mark)
   A. 47
   B. 5,400
   C. 540
   D. 54

5. A rectangle is 12 cm long and 7 cm wide. What is its perimeter? (1 mark)
   A. 84 cm
   B. 38 cm
   C. 19 cm
   D. 40 cm

6. Work out 6,478 + 2,355. (1 mark)
   A. 8,723
   B. 8,733
   C. 8,833
   D. 8,843

7. What is 63 ÷ 3? (1 mark)
   A. 20
   B. 31
   C. 21
   D. 22

8. How many right angles make a straight line? (1 mark)
   A. 3
   B. 2
   C. 4
   D. 1

9. Estimate 33 × 27 by rounding each number to the nearest ten. (1 mark)
   A. 1,000
   B. 9,000
   C. 900
   D. 800

10. What is the total value of the digit 7 in 27,150? (1 mark)
   A. 70,000
   B. 700
   C. 7,000
   D. 7

11. Change 270 minutes to hours and minutes. (1 mark)
   A. 5 h 30 min
   B. 4 h 30 min
   C. 4 h
   D. 5 h

12. Simplify 4b + 3b. (1 mark)
   A. 7
   B. 7b
   C. 43b
   D. 12b

13. What is 85 ÷ 5? (1 mark)
   A. 16
   B. 27
   C. 17
   D. 18

14. How many cents are in Ksh 3? (1 mark)
   A. 300 cents
   B. 30 cents
   C. 3,000 cents
   D. 103 cents

15. A circle is cut into 12 equal parts and 5 parts are shaded. What fraction is not shaded? (1 mark)
   A. 5/12
   B. 7/5
   C. 12/7
   D. 7/12

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
16. Share 96 metres of rope equally into pieces of 8 metres. How many pieces are there? (2 marks)

17. A bus carried 5,684 passengers on Saturday and 3,749 on Sunday. Find the total number of passengers and check your answer by adding in the opposite order. (4 marks)

18. A buyer picks biscuits at Ksh 50, juice at Ksh 80 and a book at Ksh 120. He pays with a Ksh 500 note. Find the total cost and his change. (4 marks)

19. Explain why the parts must be equal when we write a fraction such as 1/4. (2 marks)

20. Write 13.42 in expanded form and give the total value of the digit 4. (3 marks)
pages.answers:
MATHEMATICS — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #7 · MARKING SCHEME
====

SECTION A
----
1. D — 3 1/2 kg
   3 × 1/2 = 1 1/2 kg and 2 × 1 = 2 kg. 1 1/2 + 2 = 3 1/2 kg.

2. D — 0.09
   The digit 9 is in the hundredths place, so its total value is 0.09.

3. B — Square centimetres
   Area is measured in square units, such as square centimetres (cm²).

4. C — 540
   27 × 2 = 54, then × 10 gives 540.

5. B — 38 cm
   Perimeter = 12 + 7 + 12 + 7 = 38 cm.

6. C — 8,833
   Add ones, tens, hundreds and thousands, regrouping when a column is 10 or more. 6,478 + 2,355 = 8,833.

7. C — 21
   3 × 21 = 63, so 63 ÷ 3 = 21.

8. B — 2
   A straight line is a half turn, which is two right angles.

9. C — 900
   33 rounds to 30 and 27 rounds to 30. 30 × 30 = 900.

10. C — 7,000
   The digit 7 is in the thousands place, so its total value is 7 × 1,000 = 7,000.

11. B — 4 h 30 min
   270 ÷ 60 = 4 remainder 30, so 270 minutes = 4 h 30 min.

12. B — 7b
   Only like terms can be joined. 4b + 3b = 7b.

13. C — 17
   5 × 17 = 85, so 85 ÷ 5 = 17.

14. A — 300 cents
   Ksh 1 = 100 cents, so Ksh 3 = 3 × 100 = 300 cents.

15. D — 7/12
   Not shaded: 12 − 5 = 7 parts, so 7/12.

SECTION B
----
16. (2 marks)
   Answer: 12 pieces
   Working / marking points: 96 ÷ 8 = 12. 1 mark for the division and 1 mark for the answer.

17. (4 marks)
   Answer: 9,433 passengers. Check: 3,749 + 5,684 = 9,433.
   Working / marking points: 2 marks for correct working with regrouping, 1 mark for the answer with unit, 1 mark for the check.

18. (4 marks)
   Answer: Total Ksh 250; change Ksh 250
   Working / marking points: 50 + 80 + 120 = 250 (2 marks); 500 − 250 = 250 (2 marks).

19. (2 marks)
   Answer: A fraction shows equal parts of a whole. If the parts are different in size, one part is not one quarter of the whole.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for saying parts must be equal in size and 1 mark for the reason.

20. (3 marks)
   Answer: 10 + 3 + 0.4 + 0.02. The total value of 4 is 0.4 (4 tenths).
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for 10 + 3, 1 mark for 0.4 + 0.02, 1 mark for the total value of 4.
